description: live-provider.ts runStt re-decodes the entire open utterance every INTERIM_EVERY_SAMPLES (1.2 s) and again when it ends; utterances can reach maxSpeechMs 15 s. Change to: (1) LocalAgreement-2 style commit (text agreeing across two consecutive decodes is committed and emitted final); (2) decode only the uncommitted tail plus small overlap; (3) cut segments at VAD probability dips about every 6-8 s rather than a hard 15 s cut; (4) if no new audio since the last interim, promote it to the final instead of decoding again; (5) consider lowering live minSilenceMs (final pass corrects errors). Keep token timing segment-interpolated semantics and replaceProvisional behaviour. Unit tests + live harness latency assertion from A0. Largely superseded for Moonshine Streaming by B3 but still applies to the Whisper live path (auto language).

comments.text: Landed (jj rev 'Bound utterance re-decoding in the transformers.js live path'). Done: (3) long speech cut at the next pause after 7 s (softMaxSpeechMs; cutting at probability dips mid-speech was rejected because a cut emitted 'start' events that could be orphaned by the min-speech check), (4) interim promoted to final when the utterance grew <= 0.3 s after it, (5) live minSilenceMs 400 -> 300. Not done, deliberately: (1) LocalAgreement commit and (2) tail-only decoding. Both need to map committed words to audio positions, and this path has no word timestamps (live Moonshine Base / Whisper Small exports are segment-level; interpolated timing would cut words mid-audio). With utterances bounded at ~7 s the compute is capped anyway, and the default path is now Moonshine Streaming (kdl.9), which caches incrementally. Results: simulator two_cities Moonshine Base final lag p50/p95 1.26/3.22 -> 1.12/2.53 s, compute 0.85 -> 0.72, STT 947 -> 821 ms/call (one legit level-1 excursion at load 1.10 during a long utterance); Node jfk 10 -> 7 decodes, all text present. Unit tests for the pause cut and promotion; live tests 5/5.

title: Stop re-decoding whole utterances in live STT
